title: Claude Code in the desktop app
description: You’ll learn to use Claude Code in the Claude desktop app and build your first website of your own with it. No terminal needed, and no prior experience.
audience: For you if you want to get started the easiest way: with an ordinary app that has buttons and menus. No need to learn the command line.

topics.title: Basics
topics.description: What vibe coding is, how an agent differs from a chat and why every project gets its own folder. You’ll also hear what Git and GitHub are.

modules.title: Chat or AI agent?
modules.summary: The same app has a chat that answers and Claude Code that acts.

modules.title: Folders and files
modules.summary: Claude works in the folder you choose. You make a folder for your projects.

topics.title: Getting set up
topics.description: You get a plan, install the Claude desktop app and open the Code tab. No install commands needed.

modules.title: Claude plan
modules.summary: What kind of plan you need for Claude Code and where to find up-to-date prices.

modules.title: Installing the app
modules.summary: You download the Claude desktop app from the official address and install it.

modules.title: Signing in and the Code tab
modules.summary: You sign in and open the tab where Claude Code works.

modules.title: Checklist
modules.summary: All the checks on one page: is everything ready?

topics.title: Getting to know the app
topics.description: You give Claude its first task, choose a suitable mode, review the changes and learn to steer Claude well.

modules.title: Your first session
modules.summary: You choose a folder and a mode and give Claude its first small task.

modules.title: Modes and safety
modules.summary: You decide how freely Claude may act. Passwords and keys stay out of the conversation.

modules.title: Reviewing changes
modules.summary: You see what Claude changed, comment on lines and stop it when needed.

modules.title: Preview
modules.summary: You look at the site you’re making right in the app or in your own browser.

modules.title: CLAUDE.md
modules.summary: The project’s sticky note that Claude reads at the start of every session.

modules.title: Context
modules.summary: What Claude remembers from a session and when it’s worth starting a new one.

topics.title: Your first project
topics.description: You build a small website of your own (HTML, CSS and JavaScript) with Claude Code. As a bonus, you publish it on the web.

modules.title: Project folder
modules.summary: You come up with a topic, make a folder for the project and start a session for it.

modules.title: Plan
modules.summary: You plan with Claude in Plan mode what goes on the site.

modules.title: Build
modules.summary: Claude builds the site, you look at it and ask for changes.

modules.title: Finishing touches
modules.summary: You check the site on a narrow screen, update CLAUDE.md and learn how to continue later.

modules.title: Bonus: publish
modules.summary: Optional extra task: you send your site to GitHub and publish it at its own address.
